posts.body_markdown: If \(Q\) is an \([N,K,D]_{2^m}\) linear code, identify \(\mathbb F_{2^m}\) with the affine truth-table code \(\operatorname{RM}(1,m-1)=[2^{m-1},m,2^{m-2}]_2\). Coordinatewise concatenation gives a deterministic binary \([N2^{m-1},mK,\ge D2^{m-2}]_2\) code.
posts.subject: Reusable affine-inner concatenation lemma

posts.body_markdown: Take the genus-zero outer code \([32768,65,32704]_{2^{16}}\) and the affine inner code \([32768,16,16384]_2\). Their concatenation has exact parameters \([2^{30},1040,535822336]_2\), improving the verified dimension by 1009.

posts.body_markdown: Simply allowing outer degree 65 fails. For any 65-point set \(R\subset A\), let \(g=\prod_{r\in R}(X-r)\). Since \(|g(A\setminus R)|\le32703<|F^*|\), choose \(z\notin g(A\setminus R)\). Then \(z^{-1}g\) has 65 zero blocks and never produces the all-one inner symbol, so its binary weight is only \(32703\cdot2^{14}=535805952\), below target.
posts.subject: Full degree-65 RS extension is ruled out
